βρόντησε: βροντάω — thunder; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= Attic ἐβρόντησε): ’thundered’
διελθέμεν: διέρχομαι — go through; aor. inf., epic -έμεν (= Attic διελθεῖν), standing as an instruction: ’go through’
εὐρώεντα: εὐρώεις — mouldy, dank, dark (traditional gloss, uncertain); masc. acc. sg.
νυμφάων: νύμφη — nymph, young woman; fem. gen. pl., epic -άων (= Attic νυμφῶν)
οἰνοποτάζων: οἰνοποτάζω — drink wine, be a drinker; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.
πίσεα: πίσος — meadow, water-meadow; neut. acc. pl., uncontracted -εα (contracted -η)
πηγὰς: πηγή — spring, source; fem. acc. pl.
ποιήεντα: ποιήεις — grassy; adj., neut. acc. pl., epithet of ἄγκεα ’glens’
τέρψομαι: τέρπω — delight, gladden; mid. take pleasure; 1 sg. fut. or short-vowel aor. subj. mid.: ’I shall (may) take my pleasure’
φανείη: φαίνω — show; pass. appear; aor. pass. opt. 3 sg.: ’would appear’
ἀντία: ἀντίος — opposite, against; neut. acc. pl. used adverbially, + gen.
ἀπειρεσίην: ἀπειρέσιος — boundless, countless; fem. acc. sg.
ἄλσεα: ἄλσος — sacred grove; neut. nom. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἄλση)
ἐπήλυθεν: ἐπέρχομαι — come upon, befall (+ dat.); aor. 3 sg., epic -ήλυθ- (= Attic ἐπῆλθεν)
ἐριδούπων: ἐρίδουπος — loud-crashing, loud-sounding; masc. gen. pl.
ἐριούνης: ἐριούνης — epithet of Hermes, conventionally ’helper’ or ’luck-bringer’; masc. nom. sg.; the sense is disputed
ἑρμῆς: Ἑρμῆς — Hermes; masc. nom. sg. (the plain form, beside the fuller Ἑρμείας used elsewhere in the same part)
ἔγνως: γιγνώσκω — know, recognize; aor. 2 sg.: ’you recognized’
ἴμεναι: εἶμι — go; pres. inf., epic (= Attic ἰέναι): ’to go’
ὁρῶντο: ὁράω — see, look at; impf. mid. 3 pl., unaugmented (= Attic ἑωρῶντο)
